events.text: The elders of the house bring {npc} to you after the evening rites, the way a family brings its best sword to be looked at. "This one climbs faster than any of us did," the eldest says. "Faster than the masters of the world. If anyone of the blood can follow you past Life and Death, it is {npc}." {npc} keeps {his} eyes on the floor and {his} back very straight.

mem.note: chose me for the house before the tablets

effects.log: {npc} is Chosen of the Clan. The elders write it into the register that night. Your teaching and your pills will carry {him} the rest of the way.

mem.note: tested me hard, then chose me

effects.log: You spar with {npc} until dark. {He} falls eleven times and stands up eleven times. In the morning you name {him} Chosen of the Clan.

mem.note: was passed over for the house

effects.log: {npc} bows and goes home. The house does not bring {him} again, and {he} does not ask.

events.text: {npc}, of your blood a generation or more removed, has walked three days to stand in your courtyard. The house sent {him}. "This one climbs faster than any of us did," the eldest says. events.text: A letter comes from the house, in {npc}'s own hand and badly blotted. {He} has gone past Life and Death. "Nobody in the valley can say how far I will go," {he} writes. "They keep asking me. I keep saying: as far as the one who chose me."

choices.text: Send a pill and three lines of advice

mem.note: got a letter from the one who chose me

effects.log: You send the best pill you can spare and three lines. {npc} keeps the letter longer than the pill.

mem.note: was visited by the one who chose me

effects.log: You go. {npc} shows you {his} new realm in the yard, and you correct {his} footwork in front of the whole house.

choices.text: Tell the house to hold a feast

mem.note: had a feast held for me

effects.log: The house holds a feast in {npc}'s name. {He} hates every minute of it and remembers all of it.

events.text: The sky opens over the house. A road of white light comes down into the courtyard for {npc}, the one you chose, and the whole house comes out to kneel. On the first step {he} turns. "You said the blood could climb," {he} says. "I will keep a door open up there."

choices.text: Bow to {him}, as the house does

mem.note: was bowed to when the sky opened

effects.log: You bow, and {npc} bows back from the light, and then {he} is gone. The house talks of nothing else for a generation.

mem.note: was told not to wait long

effects.log: "Then do not be long," {npc} calls down, laughing, and climbs.

choices.text: Watch until the light is gone

effects.log: You watch until there is nothing but sky. Someone of your blood just walked the white stairs.

events.text: At the top of the white stairs {npc} is waiting with the crest of your house still sewn on {his} sleeve, a little faded. "I told them up here who chose me," {he} says. "Half of them did not believe me. Come and show them."

mem.note: was met again above the clouds

effects.log: {npc} walks you along the jade terraces introducing you to everyone. You are, it turns out, a legend up here.

mem.note: told the whole climb to the one who chose me

effects.log: {npc} tells you all of it, every realm and every fall. It took {him} a very long time. {He} never once gave up.

choices.text: Look at the crest on {his} sleeve

mem.note: had the house crest straightened above the clouds

effects.log: You straighten the faded crest. {npc} pretends not to be moved, and fails.

events.text: {npc} finds you at the cloud's edge where you go to look down. "I can still find the house from here," {he} says, pointing through a gap in the clouds. "There. The roof with the new tiles. Do you think they still say our names?"

mem.note: looked down at the house together

effects.log: "They do," you say. {npc} sits with you until the gap closes.

mem.note: sent a sign down to the house together

effects.log: The two of you send down a little light over the house at dusk. Someone below will tell that story for years.

choices.text: Tell {him} it does not matter up here

mem.note: was told the house below does not matter

effects.log: {npc} nods slowly. {He} goes back to look down alone, later.

events.text: The evening after the register changes hands, {npc} comes to your rooms with two cups and does not sit. "The steward asked me about the spring rents today," {he} says. "I did not know the answer. I said I would ask the head. Then I remembered."

mem.note: was told the answer once, and trusted after

effects.log: You tell {him} about the spring rents. {npc} writes it down and does not ask you again.

mem.note: was made to find the answer alone

effects.log: {npc} goes and finds out. It takes {him} three days. {He} never forgets the spring rents.

choices.text: Pour the tea and talk of something else

mem.note: drank tea with the old head the first night

effects.log: You talk about the old days instead. {npc} finally sits down.

events.text: At the clan's autumn rites {npc} has kept the seat at the head of the table for you, as {he} promised. Halfway through the meal a cousin you do not know asks who the old one at the top is. Thirty people answer at once.

mem.note: was honoured at the rites

effects.log: You keep it short. The house remembers it longer than any of {npc}'s.

mem.note: was toasted by the founder

effects.log: You raise your cup to {npc}. The whole table follows. {npc} goes red to the ears.

choices.text: Slip out early and walk the grounds

effects.log: You walk the old grounds alone. Everything is a little different. Most of it is better.

events.text: On {his} first morning as head, {npc} calls the drill in the courtyard. {His} voice cracks on the third form, and two hundred disciples pretend not to hear. Afterwards {he} climbs to the Founder's hall. "Was it terrible?" {he} asks.

mem.note: was told the truth by the Founder

effects.log: "It was terrible," you say. "Mine was worse." {npc} laughs for the first time in a week.

mem.note: was kindly lied to by the Founder

effects.log: {npc} knows it was not, and knows why you said it.

mem.note: was shown the form again by the Founder

effects.log: You walk the third form with {npc} in the empty yard until it sits in {his} voice too.

events.text: For the sect's founding day {npc} sends a palanquin for you, which you refuse, and then a disciple to walk beside you, which you allow. The new disciples line the path to see the Founder. One of them asks if you are really that old.

choices.text: Tell the disciple you are older

mem.note: watched the Founder tease a disciple

effects.log: The disciple goes pale. {npc} has to turn away to hide a smile.

mem.note: heard the Founder speak at the founding day

effects.log: You give the address. {npc} has every word of it carved beside the gate.

choices.text: Sit at the back and let {npc} speak

mem.note: was trusted to speak while the Founder listened

effects.log: You sit at the back. {npc} speaks well, and looks for you at the end. You nod once.
